either is unset). One that isn't is listed but never checked or run:
a run naming it is refused (failed_precondition, NOT_FOR_THIS_INSTALL).

vennir.console.v1.Readiness.name: Readiness
vennir.console.v1.Readiness.comment: A product's check's last answer on this install.

fields.name: state
fields.comment:
ready, not_ready, failed (its check couldn't say), checking, or
unchecked (not yet).

fields.name: principal
fields.comment: What it acts as here: an identity, an account.

fields.name: missing
fields.comment: What it lacks to work here.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The check run.

fields.name: products
fields.comment: How many registered products use it: it can be released only at zero.

fields.name: name
fields.comment: Such as gcp.project.

fields.name: jsonType
fields.comment: string, integer, number or boolean.

fields.name: shared
fields.comment: Asked once per order when no task in it provides the type.

fields.name: defaultProvider
fields.comment:
<team>/<product>.<action> added to an order that needs the type and
has no provider.

fields.name: team
fields.comment:
The team whose types.yaml defines it; unset for one set by
ReplaceWiringTypes.

fields.name: team
fields.comment: Unset for a platform product.

fields.name: inputSchema
fields.comment:
Each field below left unset keeps what's stored, except secret_refs,
share_with, deprecated and token_audiences, which are always replaced: a registration is
the whole product.yaml, and an empty list can't be told from an unset
one.

fields.name: tokenAudiences
fields.comment:
Audiences its tasks get a projected ServiceAccount token for, to sign
in to another cloud. Never the Kubernetes API's or kernel-api's.

fields.name: types
fields.comment: Name to type; 1 to 500 of them. Names look like gcp.project.

fields.name: name
fields.comment: Any of its actions' registered names.

vennir.console.v1.Provided.name: Provided
vennir.console.v1.Provided.comment:
What a resource's step provided: an output its product types as a wiring
type (x-vennir-provides), and its value.

vennir.console.v1.ResourceRef.name: ResourceRef
vennir.console.v1.ResourceRef.comment: Another resource, at the end of a dependency.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The run that last reported it.

fields.name: input
fields.comment: The input of the dependent's step it came in through.

fields.name: type
fields.comment:
What the product said: such as "gcp/project", its id there, a name for
people, and a link to it.

fields.name: product
fields.comment:
The registered product that made it (<team>-<product>-<action>), and
its team.

fields.name: ownerTeam
fields.comment: The team it was made for; empty when it was for whoever ran it alone.

fields.name: ownerEmail
fields.comment: Who ran it; empty once their account is gone.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The run and step that last reported it.

fields.name: state
fields.comment:
"exists", "deleting", "delete_failed" (its last delete's run finished
without deleting it) or "deleted".

fields.name: deletingExecutionId
fields.comment: The last delete's run, if one was asked for.

fields.name: canDelete
fields.comment: Whether you may delete it now.

fields.name: provides
fields.comment: What its step provided, by wiring type: what a later order can use.

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.comment:
What it depends on, and what still depends on it, of what you may see:
recorded when each run finished, across runs.

fields.name: hiddenDependents
fields.comment: Live dependents you may not see.

fields.name: resources
fields.comment: What it would delete, and what depended on it when asked (what you may see).

fields.name: decision
fields.comment:
"approved", "denied", "deleted" (all it would delete was deleted
another way first, with what depended on it), or empty while it waits.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The cleanup run an approval started.

fields.name: requests
fields.comment: Waiting first, then decided, newest first; at most 100.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The cleanup run, when approved.

fields.name: query
fields.comment: Matched against type, id and name.

fields.name: ids
fields.comment:
Only these (an order's chosen resources, say), at most 50; those the
caller may see.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The cleanup run.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The cleanup run.

fields.name: kind
fields.comment: "template" or "action".

fields.name: runnableTeam
fields.comment:
What it runs: a template's team and name, or an action's team and
registered product name.

fields.name: cron
fields.comment: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.comment: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/Berlin.

fields.name: lastExecutionId
fields.comment: Its last run, when it started one.

fields.name: lastError
fields.comment: Why its last start was refused, if it was.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.comment: Empty: UTC.

fields.name: managed
fields.comment: False for a sync created outside the console.

fields.name: external
fields.comment: For a synced secret: its ExternalSecret's reference, as stored.

fields.name: provider
fields.comment: ESO's provider id: gcpsm, azurekv, aws, onepasswordSDK and so on.

fields.name: data
fields.comment: Key to value; at least one. Never logged or stored by the console.

fields.name: keys
fields.comment: At least one.

vennir.console.v1.SyncedKey.name: SyncedKey
vennir.console.v1.SyncedKey.comment: One key of the Secret, and where it comes from in the vault.

fields.name: catalogRepo
fields.comment: owner/repo of the catalog, where teams/<team>/secret-stores/ lives.

fields.name: clusterIssuer
fields.comment: This cluster's ServiceAccount token issuer, for clouds to federate with.

fields.name: name
fields.comment: Also the team's Kubernetes namespace.

fields.name: requireSso
fields.comment: Its members sign in with single sign-on only (while it's on).

fields.name: fromCatalog
fields.comment:
Made by the catalog (a release adds, retires and restores it); else
made here, and the catalog leaves it alone until an admin adopts it.

fields.name: quota
fields.comment:
What its steps may use together, as its namespace's ResourceQuota and
LimitRange hold it: its own, else the install's.

fields.name: quotaIsDefault
fields.comment: True when the quota is the install's, not one an admin set for it.

fields.name: installQuota
fields.comment: The install's limits, which a team without its own has.

fields.name: retiredBy
fields.comment:
Who retired it: their email, or "the catalog"; empty while it isn't
retired (or for a team retired before this was kept).

vennir.console.v1.TeamQuota.name: TeamQuota
vennir.console.v1.TeamQuota.comment:
A team's resource limits, as Kubernetes quantities ("4", "500m",
"16Gi"); empty: no limit. The cluster refuses a step over them: one that
can never fit fails (RESOURCES_NOT_ALLOWED), one waiting for the team's
other steps to finish waits.

fields.name: cpu
fields.comment: CPU all its steps may request together.

fields.name: memory
fields.comment: Memory all its steps may request together.

fields.name: pods
fields.comment: How many of its Pods may exist at once.

fields.name: stepMemory
fields.comment: The most memory one step may ask for.

fields.name: isAdmin
fields.comment: A Vennir admin, not just this team's member.

fields.name: hasPassword
fields.comment:
How it signs in (a bot has neither): what requiring single sign-on
would change for it.

fields.name: followsGroups
fields.comment:
Their membership follows their single sign-on groups (the team is
mapped to one): their role isn't changed, nor are they removed, here.

fields.name: viaGroups
fields.comment:
Which of their groups give them their role here, as their last sign-in
(or the hourly Google groups read) found them; empty when they were
added by hand, or haven't signed in since this was recorded.

vennir.console.v1.TeamSummary.name: TeamSummary
vennir.console.v1.TeamSummary.comment: What an admin's list of teams shows of one.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment:
team.yaml's owner in the catalog and its description; empty for a team
made here.

fields.name: running
fields.comment:
Its namespace's Pods not finished: starting, running, or unable to
start. Unset when the cluster couldn't be asked.

fields.name: created
fields.comment: Whether this call created it.

fields.name: unregisteredProducts
fields.comment:
How many of its products were unregistered (they return on its next
catalog CI push once it's restored).

fields.name: alreadyPurged
fields.comment:
Already purged before this call (which then retried the namespace's
deletion, if the console may delete it).

fields.name: namespaceDeleted
fields.comment: False when the namespace stays, labelled retired, for an operator.

fields.name: role
fields.comment: Unspecified: a member.

fields.name: role
fields.comment: Maintainer or member.

fields.name: useDefault
fields.comment: The install's limits again: quota is ignored.

fields.name: documents
fields.comment: The file's objects, 1 to 20.

fields.name: credential
fields.comment:
For a provider that needs a stored credential: written to the
Secret eso-auth, which no step can mount.

vennir.console.v1.TaskPod.name: TaskPod
vennir.console.v1.TaskPod.comment:
A Pod in the team's namespace, as a task: which execution, task and
attempt it runs, and how it's doing.

fields.name: problem
fields.comment: Why it can't start or failed, in plain words, with Kubernetes' detail.

fields.name: execution
fields.comment: Set when the execution is one this team is part of.

fields.name: taskNumber
fields.comment: Its task's position in the DAG, from 1, when known.

fields.name: contact
fields.comment: team.yaml's contact (who to ask), and its help: a chat and a page.

fields.name: owner
fields.comment:
team.yaml's owner in the catalog (a GitHub user or team); membership
here is the console's, not the catalog's.

fields.name: description
fields.comment: team.yaml's description, from the catalog; empty for a team made here.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether people may sign in with the provider.

fields.name: setByInstall
fields.comment: True when the install set the provider: issuer to label are read-only.

fields.name: clientSecretSet
fields.comment: Whether a client secret is stored; it's never sent back.

fields.name: redirectUrl
fields.comment: <console URL>/api/auth/oidc/callback, registered with the provider.

fields.name: allowedDomains
fields.comment: Email domains (a Google Workspace account's hd) that may sign in.

fields.name: label
fields.comment: The sign-in button's name for the provider, such as Google or Okta.

fields.name: groupsClaim
fields.comment:
The ID token claim listing a person's groups (usually "groups": Entra
ID, Okta, Keycloak); empty: none.

fields.name: googleGroups
fields.comment:
Whether groups also come from Google Workspace (Cloud Identity's Groups
API, as the console's own Google identity, which needs the Groups Reader
role).

fields.name: googleIdentity
fields.comment:
The Google account this console reads groups as (its own service
account, which a Workspace admin makes a Groups Reader); empty when it
has none (not on Google Cloud).

fields.name: group
fields.comment: As the provider names it: a groups claim value, or a Google group's email.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.comment: Empty: keep the stored one.

fields.name: role
fields.comment: Unspecified: a member.

vennir.console.v1.Runnable.name: Runnable
vennir.console.v1.Runnable.comment: A template, or an action that can run as one, as the caller may run it.

fields.name: team
fields.comment: How RunTemplate (team and name) or RunAction (product) name it.

fields.name: parameters
fields.comment: A JSON Schema for an object: what to fill in.

fields.name: actions
fields.comment: Its steps' actions, as <team>/<product>.<action>.

fields.name: deprecated
fields.comment: Why it's deprecated and what to use instead; empty when it isn't.

fields.name: onBehalfOf
fields.comment:
The caller's teams it may be run on behalf of. When on_behalf_of_required
is set, a run names one of them; otherwise naming one is optional.

fields.name: shared
fields.comment:
Whether the caller may run it. One that isn't shared with any of their
teams is still listed (unless hidden), with how to ask for it.

fields.name: shareWith
fields.comment: The other teams it's shared with, or "*" for every team.

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.comment:
Where it's defined in the catalog repository, for people; empty when
that isn't known.

fields.name: askForAccessUrl
fields.comment:
When it isn't shared with the caller: GitHub's new-issue page on the
catalog repository, filled in with what to change, which the person
opens in their own browser. Empty when it can't be built.

fields.name: targets
fields.comment:
Its parameters that name a target (a project, folder, account or
subscription another team's product acts on), with what the caller's
teams may give each. A run with any other value is refused
(permission_denied, TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED). Empty for the owning team's
own people and admins, who aren't limited.

fields.name: previewable
fields.comment:
Whether Preview says what it would do: the action, or one of the
template's steps, has a plan.

fields.name: readiness
fields.comment:
Whether it's ready on this install: the action's product's check, or
for a template its steps' together (not ready when any isn't). Unset
when nothing in it has a check.

fields.name: examples
fields.comment:
Examples of running it, from its product's passing contract tests (an
action's; a template has none yet): a name, inputs to fill the form
with, and what it gave.

fields.name: clouds
fields.comment:
An action's product's clouds (Product.clouds); for a template, those of
its steps that aren't for this install.

fields.name: runsHere
cloudsFrom
fields.comment: Where an action's clouds are set (Product.clouds_from).

vennir.console.v1.NotPreviewed.name: NotPreviewed
vennir.console.v1.NotPreviewed.comment:
A step a preview left out, and why: it has no plan, or its inputs come
from an earlier step.

fields.name: executionId
fields.comment: The preview run.

fields.name: type
fields.comment: gcp.project, gcp.folder, aws.account or azure.subscription.

fields.name: allowed
fields.comment:
Values, or patterns where "*" matches any run of characters; empty:
none, so a run can't supply one.

fields.name: team
fields.comment: The template's team and name.

fields.name: onBehalfOf
fields.comment:
Which of the caller's teams it runs for: needed when the template is
shared with specific teams rather than its own or everyone.

fields.name: requestId
fields.comment: Ties retries of this request to one run, as SubmitExecution's does.

fields.name: product
fields.comment:
The registered product (one action of a product.yaml), as ListProducts
names it: <team>-<product>-<action> from a catalog.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.comment: After this it authenticates nothing. Unset: until revoked.

fields.name: ordering
fields.comment:
An ordering bot (decision 23): a member of its team that may run only
these templates (<team>/<name>), nothing else.

fields.name: callbackHost
fields.comment:
An ordering bot's callback: its host (the URL isn't sent back), the last
post that went, and why the last one didn't, if it didn't. Empty: none.

fields.name: scopes
fields.comment: Such as teams:create, products:register, teams:retire.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.comment: After this it authenticates nothing. Unset: until revoked.

fields.name: email
fields.comment: The bot's account; created if it doesn't exist.

fields.name: ordering
fields.comment:
A new ordering bot: a member (not a maintainer) of the team that may
run only order_templates (<team>/<name>), for a storefront or another
system placing orders. Otherwise a pipeline's bot, a maintainer.

fields.name: expiresInDays
fields.comment:
How many days the token lasts, 1 to 730. Left out, 90; 0, until
revoked.

fields.name: email
fields.comment: The bot's account; created if it doesn't exist.

fields.name: ordering
fields.comment: As CreateBotTokenRequest's.

fields.name: issuer
fields.comment: As AddBotIdentityRequest's.

fields.name: templates
fields.comment: <team>/<name> each; empty: it may order nothing.

fields.name: url
fields.comment: https://, under the install's orders.callbackHosts; empty: remove it.

fields.name: rotateSecret
fields.comment: A new signing secret, the old one no longer valid.

fields.name: signingSecret
fields.comment: Set only when it's new (first set, or rotated): shown once.

fields.name: token
fields.comment: Shown once, never again.

fields.name: scopes
fields.comment: At least one, each once.

fields.name: expiresInDays
fields.comment:
How many days the token lasts, 1 to 730. Left out, 90; 0, until
revoked.

fields.name: token
fields.comment: Shown once, never again.

fields.name: issuers
fields.comment: What this install accepts.

fields.name: hasPassword
fields.comment:
How it signs in: a password of its own, single sign-on (bound at its
first), or both.

fields.name: mustChangePassword
fields.comment: Its password was set by an admin and not changed since.

fields.name: lastSignedInAt
fields.comment: Unset when it never has.

fields.name: teams
fields.comment: At most 50.

fields.name: temporaryPassword
fields.comment:
Shown once. Empty when single sign-on is on and the account isn't an
admin's: they sign in with the provider, as this email.

vennir.console.v1.ApiAccessVia.name: ApiAccessVia
vennir.console.v1.ApiAccessVia.comment: How a caller may call an API (the gateway's rule, in its order).

values.name: API_ACCESS_VIA_TEAM
values.comment: They're in its own team (a member or a bot).

values.name: API_ACCESS_VIA_GROUP
values.comment: A grant names a single sign-on group they're in.

values.name: API_ACCESS_VIA_CATALOG
values.comment:
Its api.yaml's shareWith names a team of theirs: from the catalog, not
revocable here. Deprecated: goes with shareWith.

values.name: API_STATE_LIVE
values.comment: The gateway forwards what its spec describes.

values.name: API_STATE_HELD
values.comment:
Its backend isn't under a host this install allows: the gateway
answers 503 and forwards nothing (held_reason says why).

values.name: API_STATE_UNAVAILABLE
values.comment:
The gateway can't use its OpenAPI document (problem says why): it
answers 503 and forwards nothing until a release fixes it.

values.name: TASK_STATE_BLOCKED
values.comment: Waiting for the tasks it depends on.

values.name: TASK_STATE_AWAITING_APPROVAL
values.comment:
Waiting for a maintainer of its team to approve it (product.yaml's
approval, or a target team.yaml lets through only with one).

values.name: SCAN_STATUS_FAILED
values.comment: A HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability with a fix, or a secret in the image.

vennir.console.v1.TeamRole.name: TeamRole
vennir.console.v1.TeamRole.comment:
What someone may do in a team. Any member sees the team's executions,
logs and Pods, and runs its actions; a maintainer also manages its
members and roles, secrets and bots, and submits raw DAGs for it.
